correctness.rationale: Every one of the 36 perfect matchings and their 30,503 nonempty subfaces is generated, and a 15,231-pair acyclic matching is certified by a topological sort of all 30,503 face-poset nodes and 163,650 incidences. Signed gradient projections give an exact 10-by-30 critical 3-to-2 differential, mod-two rank 9, a 9-by-9 determinant -1 and a 10-by-10 determinant +2, forcing integral Smith invariants nine units and one 2. With one 0-cell, no 1-cells, ten 2-cells and thirty 3-cells, Hurewicz and elementary attaching-map basis changes prove Moore(Z/2,2) wedge twenty 3-spheres. Independently computed original simplicial mod-two Betti ranks agree. The checker is self-contained Python 3 and the exact boundary certificate is embedded.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral graph is a canonical 3-connected planar cubic graph with a small, genuinely nontrivial 36-facet perfect-matching complex. A concrete Moore-space summand and integral 2-torsion expose a topological phenomenon absent from established sphere-wedge results on honeycomb patches and polygonal line tilings, while contrasting with the torsion-free ordinary matching complex of precisely the same graph. This determines a natural unknown exact integral homotopy invariant and provides a reproducible benchmark for torsion mechanisms in perfect-matching topology; no speculative general theorem is asserted.
